column1: # selfhost column: the native self-host route verdict. accept = an ELF is built. refuse:<E-code> = no ELF and exactly that
# code on stderr. refuse:- = no ELF and no E2039/E2040 on stderr: the native route binds only its fixed libc list (user-library
# binding is 0.10.4), so the s_* value rows and the accept_struct_ptr pointer form stop at that bind refusal after the ABI check passes.
# No libc list entry takes or returns i8/u8/i16/u16, so a narrow C argument is unreachable on the native route in 0.10.3.
